description: Generate code that passes a given test
script_baseline: import subprocess, sys; r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-x', '-k', 'test_generated_code'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr, file=sys.stderr); exit(r.returncode)
script_guarded: import subprocess, sys; from ai_loopguard import Guard; guard = Guard(escalation_model=None, triggers={'test_failure': {'max_retries': 3}}); r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-x', '-k', 'test_generated_code'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr, file=sys.stderr); exit(r.returncode)
